source_en: You picked a good spot to loiter, officer. Something on your mind?
What are you doing out here?
Getting some air. A man like me needs to breathe something that isn't recycled twice.
Trouble finds me. I don't have to go looking for it. Not yet, anyway.
Then check in and move along. I'm not going anywhere, officer.
Still babysitting the gate, officer? Things are getting interesting out here.
Calm is a choice. Panic is for men who don't already own the exits.
Watch the yard. Something's been through here that wasn't human. Or wasn't anymore.
I always do. Trouble simply prefers my company.
